scope: BF16 -> fp8 e4m3fn / int8 activation quantizer with fp32 scales per row or per (row, 32/64/128/256-column block); optional fused GELU(tanh) or silu(x)*y; optional power-of-two fp8 row scales (format bit 3); cols % 8 == 0, cols <= 12288
arithmetic: fp32 row absmax, scale = absmax/448 (or /127) or 2^ceil(log2(absmax/448)) from the fp32 bit pattern, round-to-nearest-even, saturating
